description: A kerion is an intense inflammatory reaction to a dermatophyte fungal infection, usually involving the scalp or hair-bearing skin.
symptoms: A markedly inflamed fungal lesion may occur.
Fever or malaise can occur in some people.
causes: Dermatophyte infection, including species of Microsporum and Trichophyton.

appearance.general: A markedly inflammatory, swollen lesion associated with dermatophyte infection.

warning_signs: Systemic symptoms such as fever or malaise warrant professional assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Assessment for associated hair or scalp involvement.
